params:

  contenu: ""
  logo: ""
  entete: !r list()
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
```

```{r entete, results='asis'}
format_entete = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html"
cat(
  eduschool:::.entete_math_rmd(
    params$entete,
    logo = params$logo,
    format = format_entete
  ),
  sep = "\n"
)
```

# `r params$titre`

```{r contenu, results='asis'}
cat(params$contenu, "\n")
```
